mechanics_change_policy: Any mechanics, cohort, route, cap, reasoning policy, seed lineage, or analysis change requires a committed preregistration amendment before v5 model data is observed.

statistical_panel_design.primary_claim: Every registered model-plus-compact-scaffold system trails deterministic pick-trader on seed-paired mean lift under the frozen sota-v5 mechanics.
statistical_panel_design.target_effect_basis: Conservative against the frozen sota-v2 observed lifts; no v4 result is used to select the v5 replacement or tune this target.
statistical_panel_design.cross_model_covariance: Compound symmetry: one shared residual lift-seed draw per seed; model-by-seed interaction and repeat-averaged noise are independent by model.

selected_allocation.allocation_selection_note: Retain the exact unused 16-seed x 1-repeat commitment because the v5 Holm family remains eight. This allocation is carried from v3/v4 only as pre-data design lineage; no v3 or v4 panel was run and no seed or salt was read.

statistical_panel_design.selection_rule: Smallest allocation with 9-16 seeds and 1-3 repeats whose conservative-sensitivity familywise-power Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 0.80; retain the already committed unused 16x1 allocation because the family remains eight.
statistical_panel_design.lineage: The 16-seed allocation, exact unused commitment, and pre-data power calculation are carried forward unchanged from sota-v3 through v4. v5 requires a fresh owner attestation of unused status before seed access.

seed_panel.name: private-env
seed_panel.owner_attestation_scope: Owner must attest that the commitment and seed values remain unused, no v3 or v4 panel read them, and v5 panel execution will use the exact committed values without post-data substitution.

output_policy_amendment_rule: Any cap pressure or mandatory-reasoning incompatibility aborts sota-v5 and requires a new preregistration; no in-place result-informed cap or reasoning-policy amendment is authorized.
